curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: draw curved lines on different surfaces

mission.title: draw curved lines on different surfaces

interactions.prompt: Make a curvy trail on the sand from the shell to the leaf.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the shell, then tap the leaf to make a curvy trail.
interactions.retryHint: Start at the shell. Let your line bend softly as it goes to the leaf.

interactions.prompt: Follow the dotted rainbow curve from the cloud to the sun.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the cloud, then tap the sun to choose the curved rainbow path.
interactions.feedback: Yes! A rainbow makes a lovely curve.
interactions.retryHint: The rainbow bends like an upside-down U.

interactions.prompt: Draw a curved river from the hill to the lake.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the hill, then the lake, and choose the curvy river path.
interactions.feedback: Well done! The river bends as it flows to the lake.
interactions.retryHint: A river can bend left, then right. Do not make a straight path.

interactions.prompt: On your chalkboard, make a big curved smile from dot A to dot B.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap A, then B, and choose the smile-shaped curve.
interactions.feedback: Correct! Your smiling line is curved.
interactions.retryHint: Let the line dip down in the middle, like a smile.

interactions.prompt: Help a toy car follow the curved road from the market to home.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the market, then home, and choose the winding road.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! The car followed the bending road home.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the road that bends instead of going straight.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Draw a curved vine from the tree to the mango.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the tree, then the mango, and choose the curling vine.
interactions.feedback: You did it! A vine can make a curved line.
interactions.retryHint: A vine curls and bends as it grows to the mango.
